cases.assertion: A long ordinary or group post keeps its text and highlighted code through creation, draft resume and scheduled publication. An explicit null removes an ordinary post's long body.
A viewer who cannot read the original post cannot obtain the long body. Plain history remains readable before first applying the Markdown feature migration.
Headings, emphasis, code and permitted links remain readable. Clients do not render raw HTML or auto-load Markdown images, and ignore disallowed link schemes.
